title: HB7075 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to the safe storage of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-08-21; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260515005021 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB7075.pdf (LegiScan doc 2838191))
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2023-08-21; HB 7075 and SB 7043 share this document. Takes effect Oct 1, 2023. No amendments in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new section, TCA Title 39, Ch. 17, Pt. 13): (a) Notwithstanding another law to the contrary and except as provided in subsection (c), a person who purchases a firearm, or who applies for a permit to carry a handgun either openly or concealed under this part, including an application for the renewal of such a permit, shall sign an affidavit on a form prescribed by the department affirming that the applicant will, while not lawfully carrying the firearm, store the firearm: (1) In a locked compartment; (2) With a trigger locking device; or (3) With a locked device rendering the firearm: (A) Inaccessible to a person other than the owner or person in lawful possession of the firearm; and (B) Immovable from the stored location. (b) A person who lawfully purchased a firearm, who is lawfully in possession of a firearm; or who has been issued a valid permit to carry a handgun under this part, on or before October 1, 2023, shall comply with the storage requirements under subsection (a) while the person is not lawfully carrying the firearm. (c) A firearm stored in a vehicle of any type must be stored out of plain sight and in accordance with subdivision (a)(1) or (3).
